column2: Wild berries abound along the creek, so the hikers never went hungry.
column3: 野莓在溪邊大量生長，所以健行者從不挨餓。
column4: abound in wildlife (盛產野生動物)
column5: a + bound：水滿到邊界外溢出來，到處都是

column2: The valley's abundance of rain turned every hillside into a green patchwork.
column3: 山谷雨水充沛，把每座山坡變成綠色的拼布。
column5: a-bun-dance：包子(bun)多到跳起舞來，食物很豐盛

column2: Abundant sunshine and fertile soil made the farm remarkably productive.
column3: 充足的陽光與肥沃的土壤使這座農場產量驚人。
column4: abundant supply of water (充足的水源)
column5: abound 滿出來的形容詞：abound 變成 abundant，量多得滿出來

column2: Pressing the pedal made the little car accelerate down the slope.
column3: 踩下踏板使小車沿著斜坡加速。
column5: ac 朝向 + celer 快：朝著快的方向衝，就是加速

column2: The sprinter's explosive acceleration off the blocks left rivals behind within seconds.
column3: 短跑選手起跑時的爆發性加速，讓對手幾秒內就被甩在後頭。
column5: accelerate 的名詞，油門踩下去車速一直往上升

column2: The small inn can accommodate up to twenty guests during the festival.
column3: 這家小旅店在慶典期間最多能容納二十位客人。
column5: 兩個 c、兩個 m，像四個人剛好擠進一輛車，座位容納得下

column2: Years of slow accumulation of silt eventually blocked the harbor entrance.
column3: 多年泥沙的緩慢堆積，最終堵住了港口入口。
column5: accumulate 加 -ion 變名詞，像雪越堆越高的那一大堆

column2: Dust began to accumulate on the piano after the family moved away.
column3: 家人搬走後，鋼琴上開始積起灰塵。
column5: cumul 和 cumulus 積雲同源，一朵一朵堆起來

column2: She hoped to acquire fluent Spanish by living with a host family for a year.
column3: 她希望藉由在寄宿家庭住一年學會流利的西班牙語。
column5: ac 朝向 + quire 尋求：一路追求，終於到手

column2: The museum's latest acquisition, a rare medieval manuscript, goes on display Friday.
column3: 博物館最新入藏的一份罕見中世紀手稿，週五起展出。
column5: acquire 的名詞：把想要的東西拿到手，不管是買來或學會

column2: The patient arrived with acute pain in his lower abdomen.
column3: 病人帶著下腹劇烈疼痛前來就診。
column5: a-cute：看起來可愛(cute)的針尖，其實又尖又痛

column2: The acuteness of her hearing let her notice footsteps long before anyone else.
column3: 她聽覺敏銳，遠在別人之前就察覺腳步聲。
column5: acute 針尖般尖銳 + ness 名詞，敏銳的程度

column2: Wet leaves adhere to the windshield and blur the driver's view.
column3: 濕葉子黏在擋風玻璃上，模糊了駕駛的視線。
column5: ad 靠近 + here 這裡：黏在這裡不肯走

column2: Strict adherence to the safety checklist prevented any accidents on the site.
column3: 嚴格遵守安全檢查表，使工地未發生任何事故。
column5: adhere 黏住 + ence：黏著規則不放，就是堅守

column2: The campground is adjacent to a quiet lake, so mornings begin with birdsong.
column3: 營地緊鄰一座寧靜的湖，所以早晨在鳥鳴中展開。
column4: adjacent to the lake (緊鄰湖泊)
column5: ad 靠近 + jacent 躺著：兩棟房子並排躺在一起，緊鄰

column2: Adverse weather forced the airline to cancel all evening flights.
column3: 惡劣天候迫使航空公司取消所有晚間班機。
column5: ad 朝 + verse 轉：迎面頂著逆風，處處不利

column2: Through years of adversity, the family kept their humor and their hope.
column3: 歷經多年逆境，這家人始終保持幽默與希望。
column5: adverse 逆向 + ity：長年迎面逆風的處境就是逆境

column2: The chess champion respected her adversary, who had studied every one of her old games.
column3: 這位西洋棋冠軍敬重她的對手，對方研究過她的每一盤舊棋譜。
column5: adverse 逆向：坐在棋盤對面的那個人，就是對手

column2: Teachers advocate daily reading as the surest way to build vocabulary.
column3: 老師倡導每天閱讀，認為這是累積字彙最穩當的方法。
column5: ad 朝 + voc 聲音：朝大家大聲喊出支持

column2: The aggregate score from all five judges determined the final ranking.
column3: 五位評審的總分決定了最終排名。
column5: ag 朝 + greg 羊群：把羊趕成一群，合計在一起

column2: The aggregation of tiny ice crystals gradually forms snowflakes in the cloud.
column3: 微小冰晶在雲中逐漸聚集，形成雪花。
column5: aggregate 的名詞：把羊趕在一起的那一群

column2: Constant bragging can alienate even your closest friends.
column3: 不斷吹噓可能讓連最親近的朋友也漸漸疏遠你。
column5: alien 是外星人：把人當外星人，就會使他疏遠
column8: 使疏遠；使格格不入；轉讓

column2: Moving to a new city left her with a deep sense of alienation.
column3: 搬到新城市讓她深深感到疏離。
column5: alien 外星人 + ation：覺得自己像外星人，和大家格格不入

column2: The council voted to allocate more funds to repairing the old bridge.
column3: 市議會投票決定撥更多經費修繕老橋。
column5: al 朝 + loc 地點：把東西放到各個地點去，就是分配

column2: The allocation of seats was decided by a random draw.
column3: 座位的分配是以隨機抽籤決定的。
column5: allocate 的名詞：每樣東西放到各自的位置

column2: In her speech, the mayor seemed to allude to last year's scandal without naming it.
column3: 市長在演說中似乎影射去年的醜聞，卻沒有點名。
column4: allude to the past (暗指過去)
column5: al 朝 + lud 玩：跟你玩文字遊戲，話不明說

column2: The poem's allusion to a Greek myth escaped most of the students.
column3: 這首詩對希臘神話的影射，多數學生都沒看出來。
column5: allude 的名詞：詩裡偷偷藏的典故小梗
column8: 典故；暗指；影射；間接提及

column2: The tailor made a small alteration to the sleeves so the jacket fit perfectly.
column3: 裁縫師稍微修改袖子，讓外套完全合身。
column5: alter 源自「另一個」：改成另一個樣子，就是更動

column2: Wearing a wig can dramatically alter a person's appearance.
column3: 戴假髮能大幅改變一個人的外貌。
column5: alter 源自「另一個」：變成另一個樣子

column2: Her altruistic decision to donate a kidney to a stranger astonished the town.
column3: 她把腎臟捐給陌生人的無私決定讓全鎮驚訝。
column5: altru 像 alter 另一個人：先想別人，無私利他

column2: New drainage ditches helped ameliorate flooding in the low-lying neighborhood.
column3: 新的排水溝有助於減輕低窪社區的淹水。
column5: 諧音「啊美利哦」：啊，情況變美好了

column2: Gradual amelioration of working conditions followed years of union pressure.
column3: 工會多年施壓後，工作條件逐步改善。
column5: ameliorate 的名詞：「啊美利哦」，越變越好

column2: The heart's role in the body is analogous to a pump in a water system.
column3: 心臟在身體中的角色，類似水系統裡的幫浦。
column5: analogy 類比 + ous：可以拿來類比，就是類似的
column8: 類似；可類比；結構相似的

column2: The teacher drew an analogy between the electric current and flowing water.
column3: 老師拿電流與流水做類比。
column5: 拿水管比喻電線，一說就懂的比喻

column2: The invading swarm of locusts threatened to annihilate the entire wheat crop.
column3: 入侵的蝗蟲群眼看就要把整片小麥作物徹底毀掉。
column5: an 朝 + nihil 無：變成零，什麼都不剩

column2: Scientists puzzled over the anomaly: one balmy day in the middle of a frozen January.
column3: 科學家對這個異常現象感到困惑：在冰封的一月中出現一個暖和的日子。
column5: an 不 + omal 平整：不平整、不合群的怪現象
column8: 異常現象；反常；奇特事物

column2: Shouting at the referee will only antagonize the crowd further.
column3: 對裁判大吼只會更加激怒群眾。
column5: anti 對抗 + agon 競賽：站到對面去惹毛別人

column2: In the novel, the cold-hearted landlord is the main antagonist.
column3: 小說中，冷酷的房東是主要反派。
column5: anti 對 + agon 競賽：專跟主角對打的那個人

column2: Years of antagonism between the two villages ended when a shared flood brought them together.
column3: 兩村多年的敵意，在共同面對洪水後化解。
column5: antagonist + ism：互相對抗的狀態

column2: Experienced chess players anticipate their opponent's next three moves.
column3: 經驗老道的棋手能預料對手接下來的三步棋。
column5: ante 先 + cip 拿：搶先一步拿到消息，就是預料
